_about: Deterministic rules turning cues (from the image or described by the visitor) and visitor assumptions into a 30-second synthetic mix. Every stem is synthesised in the browser with the Web Audio API from seeded noise and oscillators; no recordings are used. Gains are linear, before the master limiter.
_level_note: Final gain = the smaller of (peak target / peak) and (RMS target / RMS), so mixes stay roughly comparable to the case recordings and never clip.

traffic_bed.label: Traffic bed
traffic_bed.when: road or vehicle cue visible, or traffic activity set to low/medium/high

vehicle_passby.label: Vehicle pass-bys
vehicle_passby.heavy_if: heavy_vehicles cue visible: first pass-by becomes a bus/truck
vehicle_passby.moto_if: two_wheelers cue visible: second pass-by becomes a motorcycle

birds.label: Occasional birds
birds.when: vegetation cue visible (potential source associated with vegetation, not seen)

footsteps.label: Footsteps
footsteps.when: pedestrian activity set to low/medium/high, or people cue visible when activity is unknown

rail_passby.label: Overhead train pass-by
rail_passby.when: ONLY when 'Rail nearby?' is set to yes

reflections.label: Hard-surface reflections
reflections.when: always; amount follows built cue, reduced for open sky
